assets.recreationPrompt: Using the approved concept board, create the fully coloured isolated watercolor village as one transparent layer, 2:1 composition. Large leafy tree on the left, warm ochre and coral cottages with indigo tile roofs, central covered well, four-post circular teleport altar at lower right, winding paths and soft watercolor edges. Hand painted paper-grain storybook look. No brush, ink creature, typography, loading bar, UI or opaque background.

An isolated watercolor wooden calligraphy brush matching the approved village concept. Diagonal from lower-left bristle tip to upper-right handle, ivory bristles dipped in muted teal paint, warm wooden handle, small turquoise bead and coral tassel. Soft hand-painted shading, transparent background, no text or other objects.

An isolated tiny curious ink creature for the approved watercolor game loading scene. Round charcoal ink body with irregular soft paint edges and a few wispy strokes, two large ivory eyes looking right, friendly mischievous expression. Transparent background, no text or other objects.
